owner: Lantea hanging oxyhelium, using the installed Aquamirae feature and block mechanics

quest.078B050000000001.quest_desc: Extract Lantean certus quartz and abyssal oxyhelium. Both justify repeated industrial voyages and permanent local capacity.

Survey submerged stone ceilings in Lantea's Bioshroom Caves and Prismachasm. Oxyhelium hangs down into water; harvest its native buds and retain support stems for later collection. New expeditions must reach newly generated terrain for the corrected habitat.
quest.078B070000000001.quest_desc: Bring recovered abyssal amethyst into the titanium, computation and submarine instrument industries to build sonar, underwater mines, and shielded naval infrastructure.

Lantea's native eels can drop treasure pouches; those pouches can contain abyssal amethyst. These are chance rewards from the existing ocean fauna, so provision repeated voyages and protect the return cargo.
